# bintables/le

> <= : `cmp`, then `setle` for a value or `jg` for a branch.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/le.pkg) · translates [std/le](../std/le.md)

Two kinds of sections:

- `emit` produces the value 0 or 1 in `rax` with `setle`;
- `emit jfalse` is used by `if` and `while`: it jumps to `{target}` when
  the comparison is false (`jg`), so no 0/1 value is produced at all.

Each has a `when right simple` variant that compares against the right
operand directly.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when right simple`

```nasm
{left}
cmp rax, {right.operand}
setle al
movzx eax, al
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
cmp rax, rbx
setle al
movzx eax, al
```

### `emit jfalse when right simple`

```nasm
{left}
cmp rax, {right.operand}
jg {target}
```

### `emit jfalse`

```nasm
@binop
cmp rax, rbx
jg {target}
```

Includes: [bintables/binop](binop.md)
